本集請來羅燕慈教練以及兩位學員繼續為大家講解及示範乒乓球發球的正確姿勢和打法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」第一擊中，大家可以學習乒乓球的發球技術，發球分為三種－上旋球、下旋球、以及側旋球。在第二擊中，羅教練教大家接球技術中的其中兩款－反手搓球、加轉弧圈球。而在第三擊，教練與學員會示範乒乓雙打時的步法及位置。另外，在「乒乓小百科」，羅教練會講解一些關於乒乓球的知識，亦會介紹香港乒乓球代表隊的世界排名。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿智彥為了得到喵姆的力量，打算讓她出道成為星光魔法之星。休伊知道後深感擔憂，決定用蒼狼的力量做籌碼，向阿智彥提議由自己代替喵姆。臨登台之際，橙真突然來到，並要和休伊一起表演星光魔法。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要幼子「搏啜」何少弘抵抗糖果誘惑並留在身邊，爸爸何兆鴻率先發功；媽媽吳若希見勢色不對，即出絕招！緊接快問快答，兆鴻竟對兒子心愛顏色、所穿鞋碼統統不了解？首項湊仔任務，兆鴻要教兒子學懂十個中文生字，但搏啜很快就坐唔定，諾懿緊急出手示範以五感教育刺激學習。其實欠專注之人不止搏啜，兆鴻教學時經常分心搵鏡頭，更漸變玩樂時間……一直暗中監察的若希，為何頻稱丈夫好虛偽？一家人視像連線檢視學習成果，結果有驚喜！
本集請來羅燕慈教練以及兩位學員繼續為大家講解及示範乒乓球發球的正確姿勢和打法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」第一擊中，大家可以學習乒乓球的發球技術，發球分為三種－上旋球、下旋球、以及側旋球。在第二擊中，羅教練教大家接球技術中的其中兩款－反手搓球、加轉弧圈球。而在第三擊，教練與學員會示範乒乓雙打時的步法及位置。另外，在「乒乓小百科」，羅教練會講解一些關於乒乓球的知識，亦會介紹香港乒乓球代表隊的世界排名。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿智彥為了得到喵姆的力量，打算讓她出道成為星光魔法之星。休伊知道後深感擔憂，決定用蒼狼的力量做籌碼，向阿智彥提議由自己代替喵姆。臨登台之際，橙真突然來到，並要和休伊一起表演星光魔法。

種植是一門學問，每個品種都有牠的特性，種植前務必做足功課。這集「大世界 小知識」發問四道有關萬壽菊的問題，各位小朋友又認識幾多？有小朋友稱在學校見到萬壽菊，認為牠和教師有關，故選定花語是「善良的教育」，但答案似乎有異。澆水是種植時的重要一環，為萬壽菊澆水前，應做甚麼檢查？而花盆盆底需要有排水孔、加上膠袋或擺放一些樹枝？打理萬壽菊雖不困難，但記得每兩至三星期要施肥，為植物提供充足養分。
大野的足球隊練習途中小休，正當他們準備吃飯糰，便吸引了餓肚子的小杉到場要飯。比賽在即，足球隊又剛好缺人，小杉便在健太等人邀請下，成為足球隊的外援球員。小杉憑著肥大的身形，擔任很稱職的守門員。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
從古到今，科學於我們的生活中無處不在。古人打仗時候使用的投石車，就是利用了槓桿原理，發射器和基座接觸的地方就是支點，而在發射器一端施加向下的壓力後，支點一邊往下，就會帶動支點另一邊向上用力，從而將放在發射板尾的石塊發射出去，這樣就能將石塊拋得又高又遠。古代亦有土人用吹矢作為武器，它又與甚麼原理有關呢？甚麼因素會影響矢的飛行距離？而木筏為甚麼能浮起？木筏又能夠承載多少重量？
巨人隊慘敗給暴龍隊，多啦A夢拿出「前路指示器」，讓大雄按指示走尋找解決方法。爸爸要去攀登尖岳，媽媽表示擔心並反對，多啦A夢拿出法寶「護身符」，見大家對功效存疑，便先以大雄作試驗。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

巨人隊慘敗給暴龍隊，多啦A夢拿出「前路指示器」，讓大雄按指示走尋找解決方法。爸爸要去攀登尖岳，媽媽表示擔心並反對，多啦A夢拿出法寶「護身符」，見大家對功效存疑，便先以大雄作試驗。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
種植是一門學問，每個品種都有牠的特性，種植前務必做足功課。這集「大世界 小知識」發問四道有關萬壽菊的問題，各位小朋友又認識幾多？有小朋友稱在學校見到萬壽菊，認為牠和教師有關，故選定花語是「善良的教育」，但答案似乎有異。澆水是種植時的重要一環，為萬壽菊澆水前，應做甚麼檢查？而花盆盆底需要有排水孔、加上膠袋或擺放一些樹枝？打理萬壽菊雖不困難，但記得每兩至三星期要施肥，為植物提供充足養分。
大野的足球隊練習途中小休，正當他們準備吃飯糰，便吸引了餓肚子的小杉到場要飯。比賽在即，足球隊又剛好缺人，小杉便在健太等人邀請下，成為足球隊的外援球員。小杉憑著肥大的身形，擔任很稱職的守門員。

為甚麼天空中會有雲？只需要水和水壺作道具就可輕易解答。水受熱時會變成水蒸氣，繼而出白煙。雲的道理亦是一樣，當含有水蒸氣的熱空氣上升到一定位置時，會逐漸冷卻。冷卻的水蒸氣凝結成無數小水珠就會形成雲。而當遇到冷的環境，雲中的水滴就會變得越來越多。當雲裡面的小水珠太多，令雲越來越重，又或者熱空氣無法承托雲的時候，小水珠就會變成雨滴落下來。當雲受到風吹時，會不斷改變位置，那麼雲移動的方向與風向又有何關係？
大雄整天遲到，多啦A夢於是拿出「按鈕門」，讓大雄的房門可以直接連到課室。大雄和多啦A夢因為地租上升而被扣減零用錢，他們亂聊一通如何製造土地之際，多啦A夢忽然想到可以建造一個無人島。

為甚麼天空中會有雲？只需要水和水壺作道具就可輕易解答。水受熱時會變成水蒸氣，繼而出白煙。雲的道理亦是一樣，當含有水蒸氣的熱空氣上升到一定位置時，會逐漸冷卻。冷卻的水蒸氣凝結成無數小水珠就會形成雲。而當遇到冷的環境，雲中的水滴就會變得越來越多。當雲裡面的小水珠太多，令雲越來越重，又或者熱空氣無法承托雲的時候，小水珠就會變成雨滴落下來。當雲受到風吹時，會不斷改變位置，那麼雲移動的方向與風向又有何關係？
大雄整天遲到，多啦A夢於是拿出「按鈕門」，讓大雄的房門可以直接連到課室。大雄和多啦A夢因為地租上升而被扣減零用錢，他們亂聊一通如何製造土地之際，多啦A夢忽然想到可以建造一個無人島。

爺爺請小丸子吃蜜瓜雪葩，小丸子被雪葩的蜜瓜形外盒深深吸引，更把它當作收藏寶物的寶箱。可是，小丸子擁有的飾物都不過是玩具，更嫌棄雪葩外盒太孩子氣，於是請求爺爺幫忙找出得體的寶物與寶箱。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
不少前來「My Little Show」的小朋友，都送上樂器演奏表演。文生爸爸展示有關瑞典樂器的相片，它貌似結他與提琴的混合體卻有大量按鍵，音色是怎樣的？這集有12歲的女表演者，帶來保養甚講究的單簧管。她憶述欣賞管弦樂團演出時，被獨奏的單簧管音韻吸引而決心學習，更提到單簧管的音調不高亦不低，類近人聲，吹起來似自己在唱歌般。表演者以單簧管獨奏樂曲選段，表演夠投入，又能否讓大家聽得陶醉？
小丸子害怕打雷。為了加深對雷的認識，於是往圖書館尋找相關資訊…小丸子聽到良子邀請姐姐參加墓地考膽量遊戲，於是提出要一起去。當天晚上，參加者在墓地集合時，卻巧遇野口同學的哥哥…

飛機起飛、風帆車前行及風力發電機的推動等都是利用了空氣流動的原理。空氣流動具有甚麼特殊性質？只要在乒乓球上方吹氣，乒乓球即會彈起。這是因為當空氣流動得愈快，壓力就愈小，流動的空氣會產生吸力，令物體由壓力大的地方移去壓力小的地方。向著乒乓球吹氣時，乒乓球上方的空氣流動變快，乒乓球就被流動的空氣吸上來；而且愈用力吹氣，乒乓球就會被吸得愈高。運用這個原理，怎樣才能用吸管和水杯等簡單道具製成一個吸管噴壺？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles! And if the dodos stop, Jammbo has no music. If there’s no music, the planet freezes! Yikes! It’s up to the boys to find the ghost, put an end to the spookiness and save the ever-musical Jammbo!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,are so lazy, that instead of helping, they become a new and increasing problem in Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant run thru the mud or kick the ball with them? Goomo thinks so.

The tiny Queen must realize how the power is going to her head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodos work hard to set things right, but without an informed boss disaster looms. Bello must learn, and fast, that preparation is the key to performing any job correctly!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will make her a loser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits and restore Jammbo’s jelly-good health. In the process they recycle their garbage into something they can all enjoy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisible weirdness. They come up with an experiment of their own to see how much the scientist likes being tested!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. And if the dodos stop, Jammbo has no music. If there’s no music, the planet freezes! Yikes! It’s up to the boys to find the ghost, put an end to the spookiness and save the ever-musical Jammbo!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. The tiny Queen must realize how the power is going to her head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. Bello must learn, and fast, that preparation is the key to performing any job correctly!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits and restore Jammbo’s jelly-good health. In the process they recycle their garbage into something they can all enjoy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. And if the dodos stop, Jammbo has no music. If there’s no music, the planet freezes! Yikes! It’s up to the boys to find the ghost, put an end to the spookiness and save the ever-musical Jammbo!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored music bubbles to pink which threatens to make everything look and sound the same! When the other kids realize what Rita has set in motion they must work furiously to restore the natural diversity of Jammbo before it becomes a big, boring, barren pink wasteland!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪丞相謀朝奪位，忠臣陸俊以親生女嬰換走龍雲太子，洪被勸冊封女嬰為笑雲公主。多年後，笑雲得知身世，往找與她有婚約的龍雲，但她把龍雲的孿生弟龍華錯認，華更當選駙馬。幸此時龍雲帶兵進宮誅殺逆賊，各人終相認。
吳冠城為兒子蝦仔的將來，離開義學，讓蝦仔入讀名校。蝦仔即將生日，城為蝦仔辦生日會，豈料蝦仔的有錢同學嫌棄其家居環境，紛紛離去，幸好義學的同學來給蝦仔慶生，令蝦仔非常開心。城終於醒悟，讓蝦仔回義學讀書。
周時新誘騙何日興做生意還債。興女何帶子誤墮騙局被禁錮，新妹周南絲暗中發勒索信訛稱子被綁架索贖金還巨債。興放棄投資生意救女，新唯有偷取贖金；幸子得恩人所救。新還債時發現贖金消失，原來絲已將贖金歸還給興。
江山家園被燒，幸得新房東孔媽照顧，並與其女孔靜儀相戀。儀介紹山到侯家工作，侯悅容看上山，苦苦痴纏。管家一直覬覦侯家家財，儀因妒嫉竟與管家合謀害容，幸儀懸崖勒馬。容明白山愛儀，毅然讓愛，山與儀共諧連理。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 歡喜冤家
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅雲濤因父去世而繼承布廠，好友金振聲提議濤假扮小職員暗中視察工廠。濤得聲獻計結識了教師柳凌姿，而聲冒充濤認識了千金小姐程南茜。其後姿無意中得知濤真正身分，並告知茜，濤和聲坦然認錯，兩對有情人終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 花花公子
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金家寶遭父經濟封鎖，賭氣與莉莉訂婚，但寶花光錢後，莉與寶鬧翻。寶父要寶帶未婚妻回來，寶找周淑安冒充，並得以復職，於是莉母稱莉才是寶未婚妻。寶未能分得遺產，莉母即解除婚約。寶終明白安對其真心，與安相戀。
莫七以偷竊為生，租住戀人阿英之姊的旅店。英受盡其姐欺凌，仍不忘勸七改過自身，七答允。可是七為幫鄰居阿海籌殮葬費，再犯險被捕入獄。英欲等七刑滿，但其姐將她賣予妓院，英不甘當娼自殺。七回首往昔，無限唏噓。
左鑑白夫婦被指殺害四大派掌門，遭武林人士追殺。鑑白夫婦及長子繼白被殺，女兒文娟跳崖，幼子少白則逃出生天，並獲天劍、絕刀傳授武藝。五年後，娟成為劍主，少白與黃榮等人組成金刀幫，追查當年四大掌門被殺真相。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保險經紀吳立品乃窮光蛋，指望夫憑妻貴，想盡辦法認識銀行家千金張英，卻誤會看護張櫻為英，力追櫻並謊稱富家子，放棄追求關心他的伍紀鳳。豈料鳳成千萬遺產繼承人，而品與櫻成婚日充闊被拆穿悔不當初，幸獲櫻原諒。

江龍往何大森的歌舞團找妹妹夏蓮娜，兄妹意外發現森藉歌舞團掩飾其印假鈔的罪行，二人欲逃走卻失敗，龍被弄至斷手丟下山崖，幸大難不死。森與手下軒利等人因財反目，龍趁機找森報仇。利因假鈔險喪命，決定燒毁假鈔。
醫生范田笙被杜濟仁陷害賣假藥，判監二十年，其妻臨死前託老王收養兒子復群。十年後，逃獄的笙遇上群，決定以無名氏身分供他習醫。群長大後辦醫院，卻誤以為仁是無名氏，聽從仁擺佈，幸笙告知群真相，並與群相認。
花王陶花癡的女兒霜月與少爺林子才相戀，月更珠胎暗結，可是才被逼娶富家小姐嚴家慧。慧其實亦已心有所屬，她與萬松齡相愛，惜遭父親反對。兩對情人慘遭棒打鴛鴦，之後更遇重重劫難，幸而天佑佳人，有情人終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 手足情深
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐振英、唐振傑乃同父異母兄弟，傑與表妹楊淑薇一見鍾情。傑誤交損友，沉迷賭博，欠下千元賭債。英私自拿公款幫傑還債，並代其認罪，姨丈將英逐出藥材店。數年後，英攜眷參加姨丈壽筵，卻遭白眼，傑不忍終說出真相。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 阿超結婚
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿超相親前遇上童年好友阿芬，兩人言談甚歡，豈料超相親的對象正是芬，兩人驚喜。太子爺欲結識芬，芬卻戲弄他，太子爺揚言報復。芬與超成婚日，太子爺要收回二人的房屋，親友遂在屋前為二人慶祝，太子爺沒趣地離去。
情賊姜維森擅長偷取女人的心後，再偷去她們的珠寶，由於手法高明，探長文包探一直無法將他繩之以法。森偷了梁太太的鑽石項鏈，從曼谷來到香港，探追蹤而至，提出只要森把項鏈交還，可以不引渡他回曼谷，但森否認偷了項鏈。森邂逅少女杜梅娜，想打她的首飾主意，結果成功得手，卻對娜動了真情。森決定重新做人，但此時得知娜罹患癌症，只剩一個多月壽命。森坦白情賊身分，獲娜原諒，在把鑽石項鏈交回探後，森陪娜到東京治病。
鐵面道人鑄成紫電劍及神風劍，吳史德為奪劍殺了鐵面，幸其愛徒姚家玉趕至擊退德。德與高戴瑞奪劍失敗，投宿韋漢雄家，二人趁雄上山取劍，殺害雄母。玉與其姊家碧將德、瑞惡行告知雄，三人往報仇，將吳家莊等人剷除。
花王陶花癡的女兒霜月與少爺林子才相戀，月更珠胎暗結，可是才被逼娶富家小姐嚴家慧。慧其實亦已心有所屬，她與萬松齡相愛，惜遭父親反對。兩對情人慘遭棒打鴛鴦，之後更遇重重劫難，幸而天佑佳人，有情人終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: Hau Emperor Falls in Love, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛延壽借選秀女歛財，王昭君不肯行賄落選。君唱出怨憤，為漢王聽見，於是懲處壽。壽施計向匈奴王進言，匈奴王逼令漢王交出君，兵臨城下，君無奈出塞和番，並施美人計殺死壽。君自盡，屍首飄回故土，與漢王夢中惜別。
謝聖視影星嘉玲為理想對像，一日，貌似嘉玲的張慧玲到公司任職，聖大喜，卻不知慧是經理周仁達的情婦，展開追求，慧無奈道出真相。聖傷心之餘，對慧多番侮辱，慧激動下自殺，聖送慧入院搶救。後聖與慧和好結為夫婦。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 含淚的玫瑰
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃秋白尋愛人江子萍不果。五年前萍為妹子青的學業而婉拒白的愛意。白遇上青並驚悉萍已死，原來萍嫁與白的同學凌漢後，難產離世。白完成萍的遺願，並與青情愫互生，豈料漢向青表白。漢終知白的苦心，退出赴羅馬發展。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 九九九命案
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝小瓊險被後父謝裕姦污，更逼她嫁給范玉山。其後裕被殺，黃二姑的表現，令雷探長起疑，可是二姑離奇斃命。瓊約會凌雲，惹山妒忌，於是誣告雲與命案有關，幸被雷識破。瓊與雲訂婚當晚，山潛入謝家，用槍指嚇瓊與雲…
鏢師劉義與助手馮鐵牛從惡霸王五手上救了少女李燕玲，牛與玲後來結成夫婦。五心有不甘，牛與義先後遭伏殺，玲被五捉去，與兒子失散。牛子長大成了幪面俠劫富濟貧，常與五作對，一次救人行動中，他與玲終於母子重逢。

epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
鏢頭呂騰空受託護送錦盒給金鞭大俠韓遜，不料江湖盛傳空護送武林至寶，空與妻西門一娘遭各派截劫，幸終把錦盒送交遜。遜發現內藏兒子頭顱，與空夫婦惡鬥，娘喪命。後遜被殺，其女玉霞誤會空是兇手，將空之子麟毒打。
莊健華被發現死於海灘，其表弟丁子傑懷疑華妻何麗萍串謀駱大標謀財害命。其後傑發現標是真兇，建議萍報警，萍卻決定殺標報仇，惜失敗，幸傑及時相救。標綁架萍子明仔，要萍單獨帶錢給他，傑放心不下，悄悄跟蹤萍……
許君傑為報答丁家珠相助解困，答應她假扮其夫婿，來瞞騙她失散多年的父親丁晚成。可是珠、傑破綻百出，令珠表哥蘇士超起疑，並收買傭人彩姐監視，終揭穿傑之身分。超欲娶珠謀其家產，惜事敗，成遂讓珠、傑弄假成真。
程允中到徐守江家中工作時，以為應徵家庭教師的伍月華是江的千金。後華往中的電器店獲聘為售貨員，中因誤會其身分而對她管接管送。兩人經常出現徐家，惹來江夫婦誤會彼此出軌，幸華向二人及中解釋，中與華共墮愛河。

程允中到徐守江家中工作時，以為應徵家庭教師的伍月華是江的千金。後華往中的電器店獲聘為售貨員，中因誤會其身分而對她管接管送。兩人經常出現徐家，惹來江夫婦誤會彼此出軌，幸華向二人及中解釋，中與華共墮愛河。
鏢頭呂騰空受託護送錦盒給金鞭大俠韓遜，不料江湖盛傳空護送武林至寶，空與妻西門一娘遭各派截劫，幸終把錦盒送交遜。遜發現內藏兒子頭顱，與空夫婦惡鬥，娘喪命。後遜被殺，其女玉霞誤會空是兇手，將空之子麟毒打。
許君傑為報答丁家珠相助解困，答應她假扮其夫婿，來瞞騙她失散多年的父親丁晚成。可是珠、傑破綻百出，令珠表哥蘇士超起疑，並收買傭人彩姐監視，終揭穿傑之身分。超欲娶珠謀其家產，惜事敗，成遂讓珠、傑弄假成真。
莊健華被發現死於海灘，其表弟丁子傑懷疑華妻何麗萍串謀駱大標謀財害命。其後傑發現標是真兇，建議萍報警，萍卻決定殺標報仇，惜失敗，幸傑及時相救。標綁架萍子明仔，要萍單獨帶錢給他，傑放心不下，悄悄跟蹤萍……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。

王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。

epg.programme_title_tc: 如來神掌怒碎萬劍門(五)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵面修羅騙小龍女服下蜈蚣毒降，迫她偷取寶物以修練「天殘腳」。羅擄走龍劍飛之妻裘玉華，飛救人不果受重傷。小龍女不齒其師所為，暗中相救飛夫婦，而飛則助小龍女解毒。小龍女與飛裡應外合，並聯同四大派終擊敗羅。
花國偉不務正業，花天酒地。一日，偉偶遇謝玉霞，一見傾心，遂請求父親讓其打理酒家，欲親近霞，又資助霞母治病，終打動了霞。豈料偉婚後故態復萌，霞施計騙偉金錢以保花家業。偉一貧如洗，決發奮做人，終獲霞原諒。
（續上集）呂麟被鬼聖盛靈囚於鬼宮。呂騰空帶同點蒼派及峨嵋派掌門向六指先生興師問罪，時各派到來展開混戰。譚月華在鬼奴幫助下救出麟。群雄被六指琴魔之琴音操縱，互相殘殺。麟與華等人歃血為盟，誓滅六指琴魔。

epg.programme_title_en: Lover Ever in Her Dream, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吳成業從澳門來港尋親不果，餓倒在林潔貞家後門，幸得貞父女相救，並留業寄住，貞父林伯更請蘇德成替業找工作。貞與業互生情愫，珠胎暗結。其後業獲老闆千金金寶蓮賞識，業貪慕虛榮，漸疏遠貞。伯死後，貞懷胎出城找業，望能早日成婚，豈料業忘恩負義，更為與蓮訂婚，竟謀殺貞，幸成趕至救了貞，並將真相告知蓮。貞求蓮放過業和尋業的蹤跡，蓮終在探望工傷的工人中，重遇業，即通知貞；貞趕來相見並原諒業，業覺悟，與貞回鄉生活。
王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。

齊宣王偶遇文武雙全的鍾無艷，王見色起心，封艷為后，艷謝恩時王睹芳容半邊醜，後悔莫及。王冷落艷，寵愛妃子夏迎春，時番王來犯，王請求艷應戰。艷大敗番王後，無意中令容貌變美，她請旨將春打入冷宮，王無奈答應。
何慧仙驚見伯父何書麟中刀身亡，報警求助。原來仙夫劉大偉與洪剛為奪麟的家財，殺害麟，嫁禍給李文中。中找仙幫忙，發現飛刀手趙標乃兇手。偉、剛見事情敗露，欲殺仙奪其遺產，幸警方趕至，迅速在24小時內破案。
陳德昌常因應酬冷落賢妻李氏，更納二姑娘為妾。二姑娘與廖畢誠有染，兩人使計令昌趕走李氏，又買兇殺其子小志，幸得老僕秋伯相救。多年後，昌得知二姑娘惡行，在誠與二姑娘挾帶私逃時報警將其拘捕，與志及李氏團聚。
元帝無道，欺壓百姓，陶安、陶國兄弟欲投靠朱元璋的義軍，卻遭奸人所害以致家破人亡。後來，安幾經辛苦終尋回妻子大娘與女兒小安，豈料欽差垂涎大娘的美色，他強搶大娘並把安拘捕，幸國帶人趕至，成功救出兄嫂。
胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。

狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為“少林五祖”。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to becom

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作,獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄,再加上責令嚴緝私鹽,二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網,白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死,一心復仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a sal

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺,遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇。途上,盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵;抵京後又路見不平,救韓五嫂一命,因而結識韓的女兒牡丹...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is

epg.programme_title_en: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people’s livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港,在屋邨經營茶樓,本想安分守己,卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁,而警方卻袖手旁觀,迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his frien

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武打明星劉家輝飾演反清組織成員,並逃難到少林寺求藝。為了報仇雪恨,他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林學懂上乘的武學。他學成少林寺三十五房功夫後,創立少林寺第三十六房功夫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿。王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town wh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿。王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town wh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang’s father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally bea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正德皇帝江南遇李鳳,兩人互生情愫。臨別前正德聲言回京後會立即迎娶李鳳。一年後,當他派人接李鳳回宮時,她已病重,無法承受長途跋涉。雖然最終及時趕到,卻在心愛之人的懷裡離世……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the ardu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬騰是雍正的密令組織「血滴子特務團」的其中一位殺手。當馬騰質疑其特務行動是否有違道義時,卻旋即變成被同伴追捕的逃犯。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad’, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主,誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍。在捨身報國的征途中,他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主。面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情,這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and tw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁,老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來,當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現,槍殺了這個賣國賊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小寶陰差陽錯地闖入宮廷,意外成為康熙皇帝的好友。此時,他又受到天地會的命令,必須竊取極為重要的四十二章經,而康熙皇帝本人也在追查其下落。聰明的小寶在兩方敵對勢力之間周旋,最終憑藉聰明才智成功脫險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable Sutra of 42 Chapters, which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intel

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 名震賭壇的千王與其拍檔受命調查一位上海賭界大亨,懷疑其以賭場為掩護從事間諜活動。兩人深入危機四伏的賭局世界,在層層布局與試探中步步為營,與強敵展開一場關乎生死與榮耀的鬥智對決。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 晉靈公寵信奸佞屠岸賈,時邊關告急,相國趙盾啟奏,反被屠岸賈挑撥,下令斬殺趙家三百餘口。幸程嬰抱莊姬之子趙武出走。屠下令殺全國男嬰以斷後患,程不惜以己子代替。趙長大,程以“雪冤圖”告之,殺一家三百口仇人乃屠岸賈,更安排他與母親相認......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」,不料該劍顯現出凶兆,將會帶來武林浩劫,而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下。蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖,將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高,令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial ar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居,遙對窗中倩影,而不相見,直至發生危機,小李才露面相告,並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥,小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰,於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助,但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷,簡直變成廢人,小李於是揭破這女人的假面目,並且設法使阿飛振作起來
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Shaw Studio’s highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述于唐朝年間,沙陀國主有十三義子,皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英,因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間,最後更演變成兄弟相殘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince,  a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝,卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人,誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發,此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the bat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害,雙腳更被凍至殘廢;長大後練就非凡武功,矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識,天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來,卻對她的遭遇非常同情,主動為她治好腳疾……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技,誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是,他潛入凌家作護衛,期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長,兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Cheng Ying’s father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling’s house where he meets his long-lost brother

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be app

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要,但卻碰上連串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄,差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fig

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Impe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King’s sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘,為了朝夕幽會,竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外,乾隆神出鬼沒,嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義,更在賭坊大破賭局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor’s sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong’s caught in the Mong’s territory and as punish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲,幾近全軍覆沒,僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺,向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」,後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終,楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手,為楊家將報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang’s escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and tea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權,甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人,之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子,於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief’s illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father’s death and learns the invincible silkwo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convoy Master Li’s wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li’s Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泉州才子陳伯卿,邂逅潮州第一美人黃碧琚,心生傾慕;後伯卿得知兩人幼時曾定親,於是隱瞞身份,賣身黃府,作陪讀書僮,以接近碧琚。陝西巡撫之子林大雄,垂涎碧琚美色,強自下聘,欲娶之為妻;碧琚父貪財怕勢,不理家人反對,收下林家聘禮。伯卿得知碧琚已有婚配,刺激過度,一病不起…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳氏家族失落的家傳之寶「金菩薩」隱藏了藏寶地點,秘密分別刻在三尊金菩薩內。保險員保羅意外地得到一尊金菩薩,另一尊則落在陳氏女兒美蘭手上。非法奪寶集團為尋寶藏下落追殺二人。保羅和美蘭為查明藏寶地點,歷盡艱辛,合力對抗,最終智破寶藏之謎,更勇破非法集團奪產的陰謀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A map indicating the location of the Chan’s family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan’s daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節,故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命,後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活,哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日本財閥小川,為奪燕姓所有之森林,勾結劣紳關甫淩,屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說,均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙,潛入密室,盜取地契。後被燕老發覺,徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花,與燕家小主人子飛,本有嫁娶之約,燕老死後,但鑑於其父與日人相勾結,國恨家仇,兒女私情無法兼顧,只得示意決絕…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming’s overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Enco

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. Wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。

原本隸屬于殺手組織“綺妍堂的柳葉桃,因不忍殺害忠良轉而保護林大人,並與林大人日久生情,令“綺妍堂遭受重創,由此引來滅門大禍。所幸死..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scott’s epic reimagining—fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者、一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了在一系列超級英雄電影宣告終結後重振自己的演藝事業,一名瘋狂的演員自編、自導、自演了一部百老匯舞台劇。沒想到,在首映禮上他試圖舉槍自盡後,這部戲竟然跌破眾人眼鏡地大獲成功
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoots himself in the head during the premiere.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1872年,一位英國發明家、一位中國小偷和一位法國藝術家出發,用80天完成環球航行。他們通過海陸空和滾軸溜冰,爭分奪秒回到起點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is 1872, and a British inventor, a Chinese thief and a French artist set off to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days. They travel by land, air, sea, and in-line skates in order to beat the clock and finish where they started.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a fugitive couples glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure erupts into a maze of double-crosses, close escapes, false identities, and head-spinning romantic snafus, they come to realize that all they can count on is each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅素克洛在雷德利史考特的史詩巨制《羅賓漢》中飾演羅賓漢——在這段傳奇中,他奮起對抗腐敗,點燃反叛之火,讓一位卑微的亡命之徒化身為永恆的自由象徵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scott’s epic reimagining—fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皮爾斯・布洛斯南主演《但丁峰》,一座寧靜小鎮面臨甦醒火山帶來的熔岩末日。爆炸性的動作場面與緊張懸疑,讓這部災難驚悚片成為必看之作!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dante’s Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德・范達美主演本片,由動作大師吳宇森執導,一場緊張刺激的生死追擊即將展開——他對抗一群以獵殺人類為娛樂的致命組織。聯合主演包括藍斯・亨里克森與威爾福・布利姆利。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this John Woo action thriller where a man battles a deadly group that hunts humans for sport. Also features Lance Henriksen and Wilford Brimley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友。當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心、身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名少林武者對抗販賣奴隸的惡勢力,誓要阻止同胞被賣往美洲金礦淪為苦役。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Killers and an ex-Army agent take part in a ruthless millionaire’s annual island manhunt.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落。一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two soldiers killed in Vietnam are revived years later as cyborg super-soldiers. But when memories return, they break free—setting up a brutal showdown between former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom—a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2210年,一支奉命營救人類、抵禦吸血鬼襲擊的隊伍,卻發現吸血鬼正密謀全面接管世界,並且得到來自意想不到勢力的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2210, a crew dispatched to rescue humans from a vampire attack discovers that the vampires are plotting a take-over…and getting help from a surprising source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在他的搭檔湯姆韋恩和家人被臭名昭彰且難以捉摸的刺客羅格(李連杰)殺害後,聯邦調查局特工約翰克勞佛(傑森斯坦森)開始沉迷於報復,因為他的世界陷入了內疚和背叛的漩渦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Police and the triads are irreconcilable opponents. Inspector Cheng leads the anti street car racing team and Jiang is the leader of the street car racing gang. While the police investigates an underground street car race, they uncover the 15-year grudge between Cheng and Jiang, and discover a hidden triad group.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Border troops are after a multi-million dollar drug deal from the biggest drug dealer but Lius gang snatches the drug away. As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. A battle between the border troops, the triad and the mercenaries has just started!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大宋淳佑七年,欽州靈龍鎮災患頻現,民間謠言乃蛟龍作祟,需將童男童女投入鎖龍井餵食蛟龍方能得享安寧,無數鎮民的子孫被投入井中。新科進士莊嚴擔任主簿後,執意要進入鎖龍井調查,卻因為誣捏他得罪龍王而被囚禁入..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ling Long Town faces frequent natural disasters. Rumour has it that feeding the dragon in the well with children will help. A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.
