epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴山劍場被滅門後僥倖逃過一劫的夜策冷,迫於無奈假意歸順蘅王留在他身邊,伺機殺掉他為師傅報仇。江湖傳聞孤山劍藏在雲來鎮,蘅王派陳玄及夜策冷前往調查,而鎮上突然傳有血妖出沒。在調查途中,夜意外救了假扮捉妖..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sole survivor from a massacre, Ye pretends to be subservient to Emperor Heng and awaits a chance to avenge his masters death. Ye and Chen are assigned to investigate a case of a blood demon. In the process, Ye accidentally rescues Ji Zhen who poses as a monster hunter. With the help of Ji Zhen, Ye unravels the truth about the blood demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..

As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu Le joins the police force with a strong desire for justice. Noting the serious corruption in the force, Xu seeks to become the most powerful inspector to eradicate corruption. Though his friend heads a triad gang, Xu still joins forces with the ICAC to provide evidence against the culprits to make them pay the price of their crimes.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..

While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄,而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相,決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵,一邊互相搞破壞,而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金蓮是扶桑之寶,卻被紅狐紅綃、白狐傾城及黑狐夜桑在爭奪時意外遺失。扶桑之主姥姥本想利用金蓮意圖掌控天下,立即命令三狐下凡往人間尋找金蓮。三狐發現金蓮附身在一個名叫張懷生的人身上,而金蓮的力量亦恢復了各..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Golden Lotus, the Fusos treasure, is lost. Fusos demoness orders three fox demons to find it in the human world. The fox demons soon discover that Zhang Huai Shen has taken the golden lotus, which has the power to recall the memories of past lives. This eventually uncovers the relationship between Zhang, the three fox demons and the demoness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 胡八一與王胖子及大金牙在古蘭郡遇到Shirley楊,得知孫教授被困於龍嶺迷窟。四人一起進入迷窟尋找教授,出來後胡和王身上長出眼球狀的紅斑,根據Shirley外公的筆記,解藥雮塵珠有可能藏在黑水城的通天..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three friends meet Shirley in Gu Lan County. They save a professor trapped in the Dragon Labyrinth, but two friends suffer from skin rashes after leaving the labyrinth. According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王生偶然救了狐妖香兒,在不知香兒真實身分的情況下將她收留在家中,並對她心生愛慕,甚至想納她為妾。原來香兒也是被巫山老妖所控制,操縱她在人間作惡害人。王生和香兒最後能否走在一起,人和妖又能否相戀?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐族女君九尾不幸落入梅山七怪老大猿猴精袁洪之手,陰差陽錯被姜子牙所救,卻被姜斬斷一條尾巴。九尾走投無路在女媧娘娘的指點下附身在冀州候蘇護的女兒蘇妲己身上。不久,紂王攻打冀州,妲己被俘,及後紂王娶了妲己..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nine-tailed Fox is caught by the seven monkey monster in Mount Mei. Jiang Zi Ya inadvertently saves Nine-tailed Fox but cuts off one of her tails, making her so desperate that she possesses the body of Da Ji. Shortly after, Emperor Shang invades Ji Zhou and kidnaps Da Ji, who later becomes Empress Shang and causes chaos throughout the realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monkey King clashes with Monk Tang on their quest for Buddhist Sutras as Tang suspects Monkey of taking lives. One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ling Long Town faces frequent natural disasters. Rumour has it that feeding the dragon in the well with children will help. A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..

They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

However, the villagers accuse a weak girl of the crime, and she herself pleads guilty due to her belief of being a lone star. As Detective Dee investigates the case, he uncovers the truth behind the mysterious murder and unveils a deadly conspiracy.

However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..

She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港警隊與黑勢力誓不兩立,一個以程志飛為隊長的“反飛車組組成反飆車隊,另一個以蔣小海為首的“飛車黨是一群黑市非法街頭飆車黨。因為一局地下飆車賽,警方在調查過程中顯露了程與蔣長達十五年的恩怨,更揭開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Police and the triads are irreconcilable opponents. Inspector Cheng leads the anti street car racing team and Jiang is the leader of the street car racing gang. While the police investigates an underground street car race, they uncover the 15-year grudge between Cheng and Jiang, and discover a hidden triad group.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源.跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往巴哈馬的偏遠地區,解開鯊魚的秘密.牠們交友嗎?牠們在哪裡生育?有品種比其他大膽嗎?答案可能有助保護這些至高無上掠食者的後代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三歲的懷恩蹺課去認識新朋友,她跟年青的獼猴熟絡起來.兩頭來自泰國馬戲團的難民,年輕的母親森別和她的兒子沙華迪,在預釋前的島嶼上獲得了第二次半野生的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Eriks head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mias life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber tree.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在動物王國中,並非所有嬰孩都能安享嬰兒期.本集會集中在四隻必須迅速行動起來的動物.對我們來說可愛的動物,在他人眼中卻是美味晚餐.像這樣的小動物必須學會快速逃離可怕的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Infancy isnt all fun and games. Some animals must hit the ground running to avoid becoming dinner for predators. Take an in-depth look at what life is like for newborn animals that must learn fast your die young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 告別熱帶地區,深入舒爽的南海岸水域.與威嚴的灰鯊,變化多端的墨魚和巨大的藍鯨相遇,並和企鵝和海獅一起玩樂.本集帶大家窺探這些海域蓬勃的生命力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證獸醫克萊爾如何盡量滿足生病無尾熊寶寶的需求,以及團隊如何拯救一隻被鐵絲網纏住的滑翔鼠.齊來照顧一隻筋疲力盡的貓頭鷹,並為一隻被車撞的烏龜進行X光檢查,看看結果如何為獸醫蒂姆帶來大驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅.現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾星期以來,艾力克一直對抗神秘的頭部感染.今天牠感覺好多了,加入了兩個學生的小組.在森林學校裡,學生三人組享受池畔教室,而華倫天奴證明牠不僅是班上的一個小丑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a terrible accident at the nursery forest school, life changes drastically for nine-month-old Alejandra. And at forest school, the students enjoy a poolside classroom where Valentino proves hes much more than just a class clown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅.現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾星期以來,艾力克一直對抗神秘的頭部感染.今天牠感覺好多了,加入了兩個學生的小組.在森林學校裡,學生三人組享受池畔教室,而華倫天奴證明牠不僅是班上的一個小丑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a terrible accident at the nursery forest school, life changes drastically for nine-month-old Alejandra. And at forest school, the students enjoy a poolside classroom where Valentino proves hes much more than just a class clown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海中最快的魚,尖吻鯖鯊通常是恆溫的,這使牠具有敏捷思維以及驚人速度的優勢.跟隨這種紐西蘭海岸附近相對未被研究的品種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before its too late.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證獸醫克萊爾如何盡量滿足生病無尾熊寶寶的需求,以及團隊如何拯救一隻被鐵絲網纏住的滑翔鼠.齊來照顧一隻筋疲力盡的貓頭鷹,並為一隻被車撞的烏龜進行X光檢查,看看結果如何為獸醫蒂姆帶來大驚喜.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果你要成為掠食者,你必須能夠捕獵.像獅子,獵豹,狐狸和土狼這類肉食動物必須在某個地方學習.這些技能都是從這些小獵人邊玩邊學開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life at the upper end of the food chain means hard work and constant learning. Discover how young predators, from lion and cheetah cubs to coyotes and silver fox kits, learn to move stealthily and harness their highly adapted skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非,春天在九月初顯現端倪,大自然生氣盎然.白晝漸長,氣溫升高.萬物復蘇,生機勃勃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是極端的季節,它劃分出了弱者與强者.它考驗著獵豹,獅子,壁虎,海龜和更多物種在酷熱的夏天尋找食物和水的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷的荷里活獅群正身處水深火熱.向北避難以逃離流浪雄獅,其他獅子來到威脅霸佔牠們的領土.當牠們嘗試回歸時,流浪雄獅又趕到阻止牠們前進.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經過幾個月的復原,在森林學校的意外使亞歷漢渣的一隻眼睛失明,令她看世界的方法永久改變.她能否克服新的殘疾並再次學會攀爬呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beni and Lala get an unexpected visit from Vet Arga, Kesi makes a new friend on Bangamat Island, and Alejandra deals with a new view of the world after the accident at forest school leaves her blind in one eye.

epg.programme_title_en: Irelands Wild Islands with Eoin Warner 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著愛爾蘭西海岸繼續冒險之旅.在伊尼什凱亞群島窺探灰海豹的愛情故事,在康尼馬拉碧綠的海水中暢遊.漫步在克萊爾的神奇森林中,捕捉到數百條正在交配的姥鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continue the odyssey along Irelands west coast. Spy on the love affairs of grey seals in the Inishkea Islands and ply Connemaras turquoise waters. Wander in Clares magical woods and catch hundreds of basking sharks engaged in a mating display.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「如果你沒有家人,你還有什麼?」這句格言於動物王國也適用.這些動物被培育成材,讓家族變得驕傲,只因家人在成長路上一直幫助牠們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The animal kingdom can be cold and unforgiving, but for baby baboons, penguins, capybaras, and emperor tamarins, having a helpful family makes life a little easier.

epg.programme_title_en: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的環保主義者定期監測眾多他們照顧的袋獾的生活.兩歲的卡路士就是其中之一.牠清醒的大部分時間都在嘗試尋找食物.雖然袋獾確實在白天活動,但黃昏才是最活躍的時段.袋獾是獨居的,但當牠們相遇,就會打鬥起來.對於像卡路士這樣的雄性來說,這關乎支配地位.繁殖季節開始時,雌性將青睞佔優的雄性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials mealtime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物,水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼.在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕.四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭.流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷.由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難.在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠.鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手.彌敦收到驚喜:孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅.現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷的荷里活獅群正身處水深火熱.向北避難以逃離流浪雄獅,其他獅子來到威脅霸佔牠們的領土.當牠們嘗試回歸時,流浪雄獅又趕到阻止牠們前進.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入紐西蘭奧克蘭附近的豪拉基灣,探索海洋生物的真正天堂.看一眼深海潛行者蝠鱝,欣賞海豚的搞怪動作,觀賞千變萬化的熱帶魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索紐西蘭北部偏遠群島三王群島的奇異魔力.與寬吻海豚一起游泳,加入短尾黃貂魚的狩獵,感受一群食肉虎鯨出現時的緊張氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著莉茲的腳步,探索北美自然界的神奇奇觀!在壯觀絕倫的珊瑚礁中暢泳,自由穿梭於色彩斑斕的海洋生態,挖掘遙遠時代的古老化石,並深入熱帶岸邊的密林,踏上充滿挑戰與驚喜的叢林之旅.在哥斯大黎加的海灘上,悄悄接近伺機而動的美洲虎,並與地球上最大型的鯊魚不期而遇,近距離感受牠們磅礴的氣勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at North Americas natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, digs for ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Prowl with jaguars that stalk a Costa Rican beach and meet the planets biggest sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 參與莉茲最驚險刺激的大西洋任務--與公牛鯊進行自由潛水.探索充滿神秘氛圍的墨西哥灣濕地沼澤,那裡棲息著飢餓的鱷魚,機敏的鱷龜,還有雖然細小卻無比強韌的沙丘老鼠,牠們的存在對維持海岸穩固起著不可或缺的作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet: free diving with bull sharks. Explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles, and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​裹上厚厚保暖衣物,莉姿向北出發,標記鯊魚行蹤,親眼目睹海冰逐漸融解的緩慢,令人警醒的消逝.​在「熊監獄」裡度過一段時光,與那些被捕捉後暫時安置的北極熊共處,牠們因為冰封獵場縮減,被迫闖入人類城鎮尋找食物,為求一餐,走上危險之途.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入紐西蘭奧克蘭附近的豪拉基灣,探索海洋生物的真正天堂.看一眼深海潛行者蝠鱝,欣賞海豚的搞怪動作,觀賞千變萬化的熱帶魚.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大魁北克的歐米伽野生動物園擁有無數的動物.有些像野豬和浣熊一樣是永久居民,其他如加拿大鵝等則是過客.他們都在初春誕下孩子,讓那時成為探索野生動物最激動的時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the staff at Parc Omega in Quebec, Canada, during the busy spring when moose, boars, raccoons, and visiting Canada geese have their babies.

epg.programme_title_en: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 袋獾可能擁有全國任何一個有袋類動物最惡名昭著的聲譽,但這些精力充沛的小拳手也有另一面,牠們是好父母和小孩保護者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. Theyre committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓.深入探索並了解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨,甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4歲的班尼和娜娜因在森林裡發生了一次意外,班尼腿部骨折,娜娜肘部骨折,所以被收容在明猩學園的診所.不能走路並不能阻止「徘佪者」班尼,牠在房間裡拖動著身體,大聲要求牛奶和擁抱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch a milestone moment when two students get their first forest time in years. And another pair of students are confined to the schools clinic after an accident in the forest leaves Beni with a broken leg and Lala with a broken elbow.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年幼的馬來熊丹尼和印第亞來到姊妹庇護所,那裡的一對朋友高寶和謝頓有著深厚的情誼.回到主樓中,診所的一個寧靜下午被兩隻猩猩突如其來的重病所打擾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beni and Lala are going stir crazy in the sick bay, but they must recover before returning to the rough and tumble of class. And at forest school, a termite-foraging lesson inspires class clown Valentino to make a finger-licking discovery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三歲的懷恩蹺課去認識新朋友,她跟年青的獼猴熟絡起來.兩頭來自泰國馬戲團的難民,年輕的母親森別和她的兒子沙華迪,在預釋前的島嶼上獲得了第二次半野生的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Eriks head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mias life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber tree.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾星期以來,艾力克一直對抗神秘的頭部感染.今天牠感覺好多了,加入了兩個學生的小組.在森林學校裡,學生三人組享受池畔教室,而華倫天奴證明牠不僅是班上的一個小丑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a terrible accident at the nursery forest school, life changes drastically for nine-month-old Alejandra. And at forest school, the students enjoy a poolside classroom where Valentino proves hes much more than just a class clown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經過幾個月的復原,在森林學校的意外使亞歷漢渣的一隻眼睛失明,令她看世界的方法永久改變.她能否克服新的殘疾並再次學會攀爬呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beni and Lala get an unexpected visit from Vet Arga, Kesi makes a new friend on Bangamat Island, and Alejandra deals with a new view of the world after the accident at forest school leaves her blind in one eye.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入海洋最黑暗,最深邃的深處,探索海洋中那些最神秘莫測,鮮為人知的生物.隨著座頭鯨橫越廣闊無垠,延綿不絕的開放水域,然後漫步或緩慢下降至海底深處,親眼見證令人屏息,令人驚嘆的生物發光現象與奇異閃耀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the oceans most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沿著地球各地海岸線探險,觀察不同自然世界的交會之處,這些相互碰撞的環境孕育出多樣而豐富的生物多樣性.觀看虎鯨展現精準無誤的捕食技巧,緊緊抓住瞬間,目睹海鷗幼鳥勇敢地跳下懸崖般的高台,與海龜孵化幼仔一起爬向安全的沙灘,並觀察螃蟹在沙灘上塑造出宛如...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Venture along Earths coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追蹤遍布全球閃閃發光的水域,從俄羅斯遠東的火山河流到佛羅里達充滿地熱的溪流.觀看海狸以巧妙精密的建築技術改變整片自然景觀,築起完整的水壩,塑造出新的水域生態;隨後,享受與海牛共度的冬季水療日,感受溫暖平靜的水中悠閒時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russias far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿越充滿神秘色彩的湖泊世界,見證生命如何在極端環境中適應,存活並改變自己.觀察古老巨獸如鱷龜展現強大的力量,見證蜻蜓從幼蟲蛻變成成蟲的奇妙過程,並隨火烈鳥昂首闊步,勇敢地穿越燃燒,腐蝕性的水域,體驗生命的堅韌與美麗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗:這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑.與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​讓時間凝結,見證水在地球最冰冷的生態系中,如何化為改變的力量.與北極熊一同獵捕毫無防備的海豹,與獼猴在天然的溫泉中沐浴取暖,並體驗北極狐那獨特而靈巧的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earths most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴.數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們回到南盧安瓜,來看看强大的曼齊族群和小規模但無畏的卡昆比族群的新生幼崽.目睹一歲大的小雪面對一隻饑餓的鬣狗,以及獅群沖散曼齊媽媽維卡的幼崽,導致她瘋狂地尋找它們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Return to South Luangwa to see the new pups born to the mighty Manzi and the tiny-but-fearless Kakumbi packs. See yearling Snowy face a hungry hyena before a lion pride scatters Manzi mum Wekas pups and leaves her frantically searching for them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來了機遇.南非毛皮海豹,薩曼哥猴子,變色龍,黑斑羚和更多其他動物感應著季節的變化.秋天使許多動物的生活發生了變化.珍稀生物現身,食肉動物聚集起來獲取優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 親眼目睹冬天給非洲帶來的死亡和復活吧.從乾旱到寒風,觀察白晝的縮短會帶來什麼,並驚歎於動物和植物在面對季節的狂暴時的生存技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the seasons fury.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻.牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線.同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 超聰明的杜利亞和沙利巴在帕拉斯島失蹤,要趕在牠們惹事前找到牠們.另外,流感病毒肆虐明猩學園,令園內人人自危.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來了機遇.南非毛皮海豹,薩曼哥猴子,變色龍,黑斑羚和更多其他動物感應著季節的變化.秋天使許多動物的生活發生了變化.珍稀生物現身,食肉動物聚集起來獲取優勢.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻.牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線.同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 超聰明的杜利亞和沙利巴在帕拉斯島失蹤,要趕在牠們惹事前找到牠們.另外,流感病毒肆虐明猩學園,令園內人人自危.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來了機遇.南非毛皮海豹,薩曼哥猴子,變色龍,黑斑羚和更多其他動物感應著季節的變化.秋天使許多動物的生活發生了變化.珍稀生物現身,食肉動物聚集起來獲取優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 親眼目睹冬天給非洲帶來的死亡和復活吧.從乾旱到寒風,觀察白晝的縮短會帶來什麼,並驚歎於動物和植物在面對季節的狂暴時的生存技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the seasons fury.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追蹤遍布全球閃閃發光的水域,從俄羅斯遠東的火山河流到佛羅里達充滿地熱的溪流.觀看海狸以巧妙精密的建築技術改變整片自然景觀,築起完整的水壩,塑造出新的水域生態;隨後,享受與海牛共度的冬季水療日,感受溫暖平靜的水中悠閒時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russias far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與朱爾茲(Julz)一起尋找難以捉摸的曼齊族群,這個族群剛剛失去了四只寶貴的幼崽,在此過程中見證一場獅子與鬣狗的對決.然後跟隨尚比亞食肉動物項目的亨利(Henry)一起前往卡昆比巢穴來一次家訪,那裡又有一隻幼崽不知所蹤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Run into a lion-hyena showdown with Julz as he hunts for the elusive Manzi pack, who are missing four of their precious pups. Then join Henry from the Zambian Carnivore Programme on a house call to the Kakumbi den, where another pup has gone AWOL.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨到達喀拉哈里沙漠的科學家並驗證一個假設:動物合作是該地區爆發物種多樣性的關鍵.觀察他們監控行為,破譯數據,並得出引人入勝的結論.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the regions species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復.他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 工作人員正計劃下一輪釋放行動,而學園內的幾名準畢業生前途未卜.經過九個月,迪娜分娩的時刻到了,但卻出了亂子,新家庭的未來變得不確定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿越充滿神秘色彩的湖泊世界,見證生命如何在極端環境中適應,存活並改變自己.觀察古老巨獸如鱷龜展現強大的力量,見證蜻蜓從幼蟲蛻變成成蟲的奇妙過程,並隨火烈鳥昂首闊步,勇敢地穿越燃燒,腐蝕性的水域,體驗生命的堅韌與美麗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Julz and park scout Simon Chulu as they track the Kakuli pack, who they filmed last year, and a Manzi faction whove ditched a tracking collar and broken away from the group. Spot the Kakumbi making a kill before a happy Manzi reunion ensues.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the regions species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著莉茲的腳步,探索北美自然界的神奇奇觀!在壯觀絕倫的珊瑚礁中暢泳,自由穿梭於色彩斑斕的海洋生態,挖掘遙遠時代的古老化石,並深入熱帶岸邊的密林,踏上充滿挑戰與驚喜的叢林之旅.在哥斯大黎加的海灘上,悄悄接近伺機而動的美洲虎,並與地球上最大型的鯊魚不期而遇,近距離感受牠們磅礴的氣勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at North Americas natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, digs for ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Prowl with jaguars that stalk a Costa Rican beach and meet the planets biggest sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊作最終嘗試,讓抗拒的母親迪娜與她的新生兒迪利娜重聚,每個人都十分緊張.伽嬅和伽麗塔正在去往自由的最後旅程,但一場危險的洪水阻礙牠們的行程,並威脅到每個人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the worlds only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters.  Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way.  Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster.  If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced.  When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Whilst the majority of us Brits look forward to the summer months, for the nations' dog rescuers, rising temperatures create a potentially lethal danger for the country's canines. In this hot weather special episode of -¥The Dog Rescuers' we see the mistakes people have made leaving their dogs and hear solutions and advice on how to keep your dog cool in the heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與兄弟姐妹一起成長讓生活變得更甜蜜.與兄弟姐妹和繼兄弟姐妹一起玩耍和外出,能幫助這些動物探索和學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch fur seals give birth by the thousands, black bear cubs wrestle with their buddies, and meerkat pups forge bonds by sharing chores-all proving that growing up in the animal kingdom is easier when you have numbers on your side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在秘魯的山脈,一小群眼鏡熊為生存而戰.孤兒阿馬遜娜必須學會獨立.老去的東哥沒時間找到配偶,很難才能俘虜理想對象曹莉達.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源.跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三歲的懷恩蹺課去認識新朋友,她跟年青的獼猴熟絡起來.兩頭來自泰國馬戲團的難民,年輕的母親森別和她的兒子沙華迪,在預釋前的島嶼上獲得了第二次半野生的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Eriks head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mias life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber tree.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在動物王國中,並非所有嬰孩都能安享嬰兒期.本集會集中在四隻必須迅速行動起來的動物.對我們來說可愛的動物,在他人眼中卻是美味晚餐.像這樣的小動物必須學會快速逃離可怕的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Infancy isnt all fun and games. Some animals must hit the ground running to avoid becoming dinner for predators. Take an in-depth look at what life is like for newborn animals that must learn fast your die young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
